title: Pair Difference Detector
description: Given an integer array and a non-negative value k, determine whether two different elements have an absolute difference of exactly k.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers. Third line: k.
outputFormat: Print YES if such a pair exists, otherwise print NO.
hints: For each value x, check whether x-k or x+k has already been seen.

examples.explanation: The values 1 and 7 differ by exactly 6.
No two values have an absolute difference of 4.
